newsitem.title: USA: Ensec Intl sees increased revenues in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Ensec Intl sees increased revenues in Q4.

text.p: Ensec International Inc said Thursday that it expects increased revenues in the fourth quarter of 1996 as a result of increased bookings in the third quarter of this year.
Revenues for the third quarter of 1996 were $1,737,132, compared to $1,654,035 for the third quarter of 1995, Ensec said.
The company reported a net loss of $2,047,466, or $0.55 per share, for the third quarter of 1996, compared to a net loss of $1,909,831, or $0.49 per share, for the comparable 1995 period.
Ensec said that the loss for 1996 includes an $800,000 charge for interest incurred in connection with the bridge financing which was repaid at the end of September 1996.
